title: San Antonio Housing Market: The September 2026 Numbers, Explained
seo_title: San Antonio Housing Market Report, September 2026 | Kanye Concierge 360
description: San Antonio's September 2026 housing numbers: median price $302,999, 88 days on market, 5.95 months of inventory. What it means for buyers and sellers, in plain English.
keywords: is San Antonio a buyers market
San Antonio real estate market report
intro: Every month we break down the San Antonio housing numbers so you don't have to dig through reports. Here's September 2026.

items: Homes sold: 2,793, down about 1% from a year ago
Sold at: 92.4% of original list price

sections.h2: What it means if you're buying
items: More choice: inventory is up and homes sit longer
More leverage: ask for closing-cost help or repairs
Insurance: Texas homeowners insurance filings since July averaged a 4.3% decrease

sections.h2: What it means if you're selling
items: Price right: homes that start too high are the ones that sit
Watch pending sales: down 16%, so buyers are more careful
Prepare: repairs, photos and easy showings win in a slower market

faq.q: Is San Antonio a buyer's market right now?
faq.a: Conditions lean toward buyers more than a year ago: 5.95 months of inventory, 88 days on market and homes selling for 92.4% of original list price in September 2026.

faq.q: What is the median home price in San Antonio?
faq.a: $302,999 for the San Antonio metro in September 2026, according to SABOR.
